title: 第22章 门主第23章 威胁
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“你就是方门主？”
见到本人，石泉水以为看错了人。
眼前不就是柳无志妹妹吗？
他在找到此地时，就发觉上下穿着丧服，并没觉得奇怪。
“石哥哥，我不能是方门主吗？”
“可你是姓柳，怎么姓方？”
“是啊，我是姓柳，我叫柳无无，至于为何姓方，是因为我柳家门下有九里十八铺，共十三个家族，所以历任门主都叫方。”
石泉水还是没明白为何叫方，不过看到她无碍，心里涌起了愧疚。
“你哥……”
“石哥哥，别难过了，哥让我们离开时就说可能回不来了。”
柳无无努力克制着自己情绪，可见到了石泉水，眼泪还是不争气的夺眶而出。
哭了好一会，心情才平复了一些。
“石哥哥，这里是九十八铺，我是代掌门。哥走时，一定要让你当掌门人，否则就是死不瞑目。”
石泉水扯上脸上的人皮面具，暗暗叹了一口气，“你知道杀你哥的是紫煌宗的人。”
“我知道，我也知道石哥哥会替我报仇，但紫煌宗势力庞大，哥哥一个人怎么做的到？”
柳无无一边说一边请他坐下。
“再怎么样，人多总是力量大，哪怕打探一些消息，总也方便一些。何况，石哥哥的人皮面具实在太差，我都能一眼看出破绽了。”
石泉水港地点了点头。这面具可是花了上百两银子，居然被看出破绽了。
他本想拒绝，毕竟惹了不该惹的宗门，若仇人找上门来，岂不是连累这么多年。
可一想如果直接离开，怕也不妥，总不能真的看着柳家基业被他人窃取。

若如此，他死了还有什么脸去见柳无志。
“这样也好，但门主我做不了，我不喜欢被束缚。回头我给你们一些修炼之法和丹药，其它的事情我不想谈。”
柳无无听得出他不想再在这话题上再扯下去，便也不再坚持。
“石哥哥，九里十八铺共有门人3891人，连带他们家人，共三万余人，主要生意是水路运输，生意好时，一年也能有十几万银子。”
柳无无顿了顿，看石泉水有些魂不舍色，便坐在旁边椅子上，看了圈厅内，不由叹了一口气。
“哥哥不在了，若有急事，我这女子怕镇不住场面，到时，还得哥哥出面。”
石泉水急着想去报仇，转念一想这报仇事不能太过心急。
加上柳无无说的不无道理，便决定先住下来。
反正有商城，积分也足够，想到这，他心里顿时有了计划。
“也罢，我暂时就先住下来，回头.....”
正说着，一光着上身的彪形大汉大步走入大厅。
“门主，王家又来人了，还劝说兄弟们都去他们王家，还说什么柳家男人死光了，要靠女人来撑场面。”
来人声音入场，但眉宇间充满了怒火，只是碍于有外人在不便发作。
content_en:
"Are you the leader of Fang Sect?"
Seeing himself, Shi Quanshui thought he had seen the wrong person.
Isn't it sister Liu Wuzhi in front of me?
When he found this place, he noticed that everyone was wearing mourning clothes, but he didn't find it strange.
"Brother Shi, can't I be the leader of Fang Sect?"
"But your surname is Liu, why is your surname Fang?"
"Yes, my surname is Liu, and my name is Liu Wuwu. As for why I am surnamed Fang, it is because my Liu family has nine li and eighteen shops, a total of thirteen families, so all the previous owners are named Fang."
Shi Quanshui still didn't understand why he called Fang, but seeing that she was fine, he felt guilty in his heart.
"Your brother..."
"Brother Shi, don't be sad. When we left, we said we might not be able to come back."
Liu Wuwu tried hard to control his emotions, but when he saw the stone spring water, tears still came out of his eyes.
After crying for a while, I finally calmed down a bit.
"Brother Shi, this is No. 98 Shop, and I am the acting head. When I leave, I must let you be the head, otherwise I will die in peace."
Shi Quanshui pulled the human skin mask on his face and sighed secretly, "You know the person who killed your brother was a member of the Zihuang Sect."
"I know, and I also know that Brother Shi will avenge me, but the Zihuang Sect is so powerful, how can I do it alone?"
Liu Wuwu asked him to sit down as he spoke.
"No matter what, there is always strength in numbers, and it is always more convenient to find out some information. Besides, Brother Shi's human skin mask is so bad that I can see the flaws at a glance."
Shiquanshuigang nodded. This mask cost hundreds of taels of silver, but its flaws were discovered.
He originally wanted to refuse. After all, he had offended the sect that he shouldn't have offended. If the enemy came to visit him, wouldn't he be in trouble for so many years?
But when I thought about it, it wouldn't be right if I left directly. I couldn't really watch the Liu family's foundation being stolen by others.
If so, how could he have the face to see Liu Wuzhi after he died?
"That's fine, but I can't do it as a sect leader. I don't like to be restrained. I'll give you some cultivation methods and elixirs later. I don't want to talk about other things."
Liu Wuwu could tell that he didn't want to talk about this topic anymore, so he stopped insisting.
"Brother Shi, Jiuli Shibapu has a total of 3,891 people, including their families, a total of more than 30,000 people. The main business is water transportation. When the business is good, you can make hundreds of thousands of silver a year."
Liu Wuwu paused for a moment, looking at the stone spring water with some dismay. He sat on the chair next to him, looked around the hall, and couldn't help but sigh.
"Brother is gone. If there is an emergency, I am afraid that I, a woman, will not be able to control the situation. When the time comes, my brother will have to step forward."
Shi Quanshui was anxious to get revenge, but then he thought about not being too impatient about revenge.
In addition, what Liu Wuwu said was quite reasonable, so he decided to stay first.
Anyway, there is a mall and enough points. Thinking of this, he suddenly had a plan in mind.
"That's alright, I'll stay here for the time being and come back..."
Just as he was talking, a shirtless burly man strode into the hall.
"Master, someone from the Wang family is here again. They also persuaded the brothers to go to their Wang family. They also said that all the men in the Liu family are dead and they have to rely on women to support the scene."
The voice of the visitor came in, but his brows were full of anger, which was just because it was inconvenient to have an outsider.
